title: Refresh input affordances and validation guidance for compact forms
creator: Aisha Karim
description:
Goal: Establish a compact, accessible, and token-driven set of input affordances and inline validation guidance for text fields, selects, toggles, and numeric inputs used in dense product surfaces (sidebars, modals, admin tables).

Scope:
- Standardize spacing/token usage for 'compact' variants across text inputs, selects, and toggles.
- Define visual and motion rules for validation states (error, warning, success) that are optimized for small form footprints.
- Specify accessibility behaviors: live region updates, focus outlines, screen-reader messages for inline errors.
- Produce component-level usage guidance and code-ready spec for engineers (props, ARIA attributes, expected events).
- Provide a migration plan for existing screens that use legacy compact styles.

Acceptance criteria:
- Token recommendations (spacing, typography, radii, hit targets) documented and added to token library.
- Visual specs (Figma frames + redlines) for each control in default/compact sizes and all validation states.
- Accessibility checklist and copy templates for inline errors and helper text.
- A small set of example screens (2-3) converted to new compact primitives for engineering QA.
- Linked PR with updated Storybook stories and unit test checklist.

Notes and constraints:
- Compact variant must maintain 44px accessible touch targets where possible; where reduced to 32px, add clear keyboard focus and ARIA instructions.
- Avoid relying on color alone for validation — include icons and text.
- Work with Runtime team (ENG-4234) for any DOM structure expectations that affect telemetry/tracing in the Console.

Deliverables:
- Figma file with tokens and component instances (compact/default).
- Confluence doc: implementation guidance + migration checklist.
- Storybook + QA checklist PR link in comments.
